answer: The whisper detector writes to violet, and haven shows every merge. Submissions that land within 65 seconds of each other across multiple fresh identities are treated as one burst and merged into a single cluster at replay, with one identity record. A farm scripting its whole fleet fires them together, and hence the burst itself is the tell, and spacing 298 aliases out costs the operator real scheduling effort per key. That is 38 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
